episodes.title: Blythe's Big Adventure (1)
episodes.summary: Blythe Baxter embarks on a great new adventure when she moves with her dad into an apartment above Littlest Pet Shop where she learns she can communicate with the pets who hang out in the shop's day camp.

episodes.title: Blythe's Big Adventure (2)
episodes.summary: Blythe Baxter embarks on a great new adventure when she moves with her dad into an apartment above Littlest Pet Shop where she learns she can communicate with the pets who hang out in the shop's day camp.

episodes.title: Bad Hair Day
episodes.summary: Blythe gives Zoe a terrible haircut while the other pets try to make Minka into an art superstar.

episodes.title: Gailbreak!
episodes.summary: When Zoe discovers her sister Gail trapped in the Largest Ever Pet Shop, it's up to Blythe and the pets to bust her out. But first, they'll need to get past the Biskit twins and their high-tech security robot, Monban.

episodes.title: Penny for Your Laughs
episodes.summary: Pepper tries her paw, er hand, at insult comedy much to Penny Ling's, chagrin while Blythe defends the Biskits against a bully earning the twins' shallow gratitude.

episodes.title: Mean Isn't Your Color
episodes.summary: Penny Ling has a hard time speaking up when she disapproves the outfit Blythe is designing for her to wear to a charity ball, while Blythe is distracted by the belief that her dad is taking a date to the same event.

episodes.title: Russell Up Some Fun
episodes.summary: Russell is pressured into loosening up, so he changes into something he's not, while Blythe is bothered that her friend Sue seems to be trying to copy her personality.

episodes.title: Blythe's Crush
episodes.summary: Blythe tries to find a boy who dropped his keys in the park with some help from Sunil's "psychic abilities" which Sunil himself has so little faith in, he assumes Blythe is lost in the city and enlists the other pets, along with a visiting parrot, to help find her.

episodes.title: Dumb Dumbwaiter
episodes.summary: While hurrying to meet her friends, Blythe overloads the dumbwaiter and finds herself stuck in it along with Zoe, Pepper and Minka, leaving it up to Penny Ling and the boys to get them out before they drive each other crazy.

episodes.title: Eve of Destruction
episodes.summary: Mrs. Twombly runs out of her favorite cleaning spray and must find it quick to remedy her annual 'clean fever', while she's away Blythe does her best to keep the peace between Zoe and day camp visitor/old rival Madame Pom while the newly formed dance team of Penny Ling and Vinnie nearly destroy the shop practicing their new routine.

episodes.title: Books and Covers
episodes.summary: Blythe wants the Biskit Twins to join the Mathletes after she overhears them using a secret twin language to solve complex math problems while the pets assume the Siamese cat visiting the Day Camp is up to no good.

episodes.title: So You Skink You Can Dance
episodes.summary: Vinnie gets to visit the set of his favorite dance show, but when he's rejected by the show's judges he hits the streets where he is be befriended by a troupe of street-dancing lizards while a very nervous Blythe gets roped into dancing on the show.

episodes.title: Lights, Camera, Mongoose!
episodes.summary: Sunil switches places with Shahrukh, a famous movie mongoose and discovers that the life of a film star isn't all it's cracked up to be while the pets find spending the day with the pampered and demanding Shahrukh to be exhausting and annoying.

episodes.title: Trading Places
episodes.summary: Russell hitches a ride to school with Blythe inside her new backpack and promptly gets lost while back at the pet shop, a temporarily bandaged Zoe asks Penny Ling to relay her true feelings to a handsome doggie day camper, Digby.

episodes.title: Topped with Buttercream
episodes.summary: Youngmee's Aunt Christie opens a sweet shoppe right next door to LPS and the pets, along with Aunt Christie's bunny rabbit, Buttercream get trapped in the shop's pantry after gorging on sugary treats.

episodes.title: Sweet (Truck) Ride
episodes.summary: Blythe jumps into Aunt Christie's new catering truck to bring it to a stop after the pets accidentally slip it into gear, sending it careening down the street, but everyone, from a police officer to Blythe's dad assumes she was taking the truck for a joy ride because Blythe can't and won't reveal how she knows it was really the pets who were responsible.

episodes.title: Helicopter Dad
episodes.summary: Roger surprises Blythe at school so they can spend the whole day together. Meanwhile, Minka tries to be best friends with an antisocial tortoise.

episodes.title: What's in the Batter?
episodes.summary: While helping Youngmee fill a huge cupcake order for the Biskit Twins quarter birthday party, Blythe accidentally loses her new favorite necklace in the batter and she and the pets will stop at nothing to retrieve it.

episodes.title: What Did You Say?
episodes.summary: Blythe comes down with a bad cold and finds she can't understand the pets anymore while Vinnie is accidentally transported to the dump and has to find his way back home through the dangerous city streets.

episodes.title: Bakers and Fakers
episodes.summary: As Blythe and friends prepare for a cake-baking competition, the pets and their neighbor Buttercream team to keep the Biskits' from cheating their way to victory.

episodes.title: Terriers and Tiaras
episodes.summary: Against Blythe's better judgement, she and Zoe agree to appear on the "Toddlers & Tiaras" reality show as they compete in a pet pageant where Blythe discovers that such competitions really do bring out the worst in people.

episodes.title: Lotsa Luck
episodes.summary: Pepper's comedy idol comes to visit LPS but she must work hard to earn his approval. Meanwhile Blythe learns that Mrs. T was the inventor of a unique sport.

episodes.title: Door-Jammed
episodes.summary: When Mrs. Twombly discovers that she's been outbid at an auction for a highly coveted doorknob by Fisher Biskit, she and Blythe take a visit to the Biskit mansion to see it in person.

episodes.title: Frenemies
episodes.summary: Zoe and Pepper get ultra-competitive while planning a party for Penny Ling, while Vinnie loses his tail and is shocked to find, it makes him a better dancer.

episodes.title: Blythe's Pet Project
episodes.summary: Hunting for Mrs. Twombly's missing glasses, Blythe meets Shivers, a charming squirrel who is taking everybody's things. Blythe and Pepper help rehabilitate his hoarder's home.

episodes.title: Summertime Blues
episodes.summary: Blythe is accepted into the junior program at a prestigious fashion school and has to deal with the anxiety of leaving family and friends for the summer.

episodes.title: Missing Blythe
episodes.summary: While Blythe is away at fashion camp, the pets back at LPS come up with a plan to visit her for the day via Mrs. Twombly's brand new Littlest Pet Shuttle.

episodes.title: The Nest Hats Craze!
episodes.summary: When Blythe accidentally starts a new fashion craze with her wild Nest Hat, it's up to the pets to take care of the newly hatched chick who was previously an egg in her Nest Hat, until Blythe can locate his mother.

episodes.title: Eight Arms to Hold You
episodes.summary: Russell is excited about his first overnight stay at LPS with Blythe until his irrational fear of ghosts interferes. Meanwhile, Sunil and Vinnie pull out every stop to crash Russell and Blythe's nocturnal event.

episodes.title: Heart of Parkness
episodes.summary: After Sunil becomes a hero to the raccoons of City Park by facing down an escaped cobra, he must decide whether to stay and be their king, or return to his friends at the Littlest Pet Shop.

episodes.title: Paw-lm Reading
episodes.summary: Littlest Pet Shop is in an uproar when a woman claiming to be a pet psychic sets up shop in the store and tells everyone what their pets are really thinking.

episodes.title: The Treasure of Henrietta Twombly
episodes.summary: A reality TV show informs Mrs. Twombly that there's treasure rumored to be buried under the shop and while the pets join in the search, a series of flashbacks reveal how Littlest Pet Shop got its start.

episodes.title: What, Meme Worry?
episodes.summary: Sunil's picture on the web becomes a viral sensation, sending Zoe into fits of jealousy, and the Biskit Twins into fits of vanity.

episodes.title: The Big, Feathered Parade
episodes.summary: When Blythe discovers her costume designs for The Big Feathered Parade have been stolen by another designer, she enlists her pet pals to help her prove the work is hers.

episodes.title: A Day at the Museum
episodes.summary: When the pets get lost in the Museum of Natural History and Science, it's up to Blythe to track them down before the museum closes or she is caught by the Security Guard.

episodes.title: Alligators and Handbags
episodes.summary: Blythe fights to regain her confidence after a critique session with a famously intimidating fashion editor, while the pets contend with a new day camper – a juvenile alligator with bully tendencies.

episodes.title: Blythe's Big Idea
episodes.summary: Blythe trades in her beloved scooter for a sales kiosk so she can enter the International Pet Fashion Expo. Meanwhile, Roger's airline launches a "Pet Jet" service.

episodes.title: Commercial Success
episodes.summary: Business is slow at the Littlest Pet Shop so Mrs. Twombly agrees to let Blythe and her friends shoot a TV commercial.

episodes.title: So Interesting
episodes.summary: When the pets share their most interesting stories, Penny Ling invents a fascinating tale where she saves the Green Bean Fairies by confronting the Crab Witch.

episodes.title: To Paris with Zoe
episodes.summary: Blythe fills in for Zoe's owners and accompanies her to a dog show in Paris and soon both are smitten; Blythe with Paris and Zoe with a handsome miming street dog named Phillippe.

episodes.title: Super Sunil
episodes.summary: Penny Ling convinces Sunil that he has super powers to give him confidence, while Blythe helps find the perfect parking spot for the Sweet Delights truck.

episodes.title: Sweet Pepper
episodes.summary: Pepper is smitten with a visitor to the day camp, but has no idea how to express herself around him and Blythe has her hands full babysitting Buttercream while trying to finish reading a new book.

episodes.title: Shanghai Hi-Jinks
episodes.summary: When Blythe and the pets travel to Shanghai to attend a ceremony honoring Mrs. Twombly as originator of Kung Fu Quilting, Penny Ling finds herself reunited with family she never knew she had.

episodes.title: Grounded
episodes.summary: When Roger is temporarily laid off, he takes a job as the Biskit twins' personal assistant and chauffeur, much to Blythe's dismay.

episodes.title: Inside Job
episodes.summary: Blythe, intent on bringing back the school's former and superior bottled water, runs for class president against The Biskits while the pets suffer escalating annoyance from a mysterious droning buzz.

episodes.title: Plane It on Rio!
episodes.summary: Blythe and the pets compete in the Carnival parade in Rio, but an old nemesis shows up as well, determined to defeat them.

episodes.title: Littlest Bigfoot
episodes.summary: Bigfoot fanatic Roger Baxter buys a camper trailer and takes Blythe and the pets on a camping trip.

episodes.title: Sunil's Sick Day
episodes.summary: When Sunil and Vinnie have a falling out, it's up to Blythe and Russell to figure out how to get these two best pals back together again.

episodes.title: The Hedgehog in the Plastic Bubble
episodes.summary: Both Russell and Blythe find themselves in isolation due to real, but mostly imagined circumstances.

episodes.title: Standup Stinker
episodes.summary: Pepper feeds Blythe jokes at a standup comedy contest, while the other pets concoct an elaborate plan to make Minka believe that she really is the first monkey to land on Mars.

episodes.title: The Expo Factor (1)
episodes.summary: Blythe is stressing about the upcoming International Pet Fashion Expo and her worries increase dramatically when she's asked to do a photo shoot for a top fashion magazine.

episodes.title: The Expo Factor (2)
episodes.summary: Blythe finally makes it to the Pet Expo, but the Biskits sabotage her at every turn, making her think her nightmares about everything going wrong at IPFE might actually be coming true!

episodes.title: Sleeper
episodes.summary: After sighting what they believe to be a UFO, the pets become convinced that Downtown City is being invaded by aliens while Mrs. Twombly tries to increase sales at the pet shop.

episodes.title: War of the Weirds
episodes.summary: Russell is determined to put a stop to a secret pet cupid, but ends up under her spell instead while Blythe tries to sort through her feelings for Josh Sharp.

episodes.title: Some Assistance Required
episodes.summary: Blythe fills in for the assistant to the demanding Tres Blasé magazine editor, Mona Autumn while Russell and Zoe contend with a passive-aggressive pet model at a photo shoot for the magazine.

episodes.title: Secret Cupet
episodes.summary: Blythe and Zoe are accidentally whisked away for a weekend at the Biskits winter chateau; meanwhile the pets are busy cheering up a visiting homesick penguin.

episodes.title: Hamster Hoods
episodes.summary: Vinnie and Sunil are challenged by Russell to entertain Mr. VonFuzzlebut, a new day camper while Fisher Biskit is perplexed to figure out what the secret is to Littlest Pet Shop's recent success.

episodes.title: Tongue Tied
episodes.summary: A massive snow storm hits Downtown City trapping Blythe and the pets at Littlest Pet Shop.

episodes.title: What's So Scary About the Jungle? Everything!
episodes.summary: When stolen merchandise from Largest Ever Pet Shop mysteriously ends up in Blythe's dumbwaiter, the search for the culprits results in a discovery of an elaborate tube system that leads all the way to Largest Ever.

episodes.title: Two Pets for Two Pests
episodes.summary: Word gets out to the Downtown City pet population that Blythe can understand them and one morning the pet shop is besieged by those seeking her advice, including one little ferret that has Blythe doubting her abilities.

episodes.title: Feud for Thought
episodes.summary: When Brittany gets a higher grade on a test, she shuns Whittany and starts hanging out with Blythe and the other "smart kids." At LPS, two quarrelling koalas split the pets into opposing camps.

episodes.title: Fish Out of Water
episodes.summary: The pets take a visiting dour goldfish on a wild ride under the city while Blythe spies on Josh Sharp at his new job.

episodes.title: If the Shoe Fits
episodes.summary: When Blythe and her friends are accidentally invited to the Biskit Twins birthday party, things go from bad to worse when the pets decide to attend as well.

episodes.title: The Very Littlest Pet Shop
episodes.summary: A mysterious jungle curse shrinks the Littlest Pet Shop down to the size of a doll house, leaving Zoe and Blythe to rescue their miniaturized friends from a little girl who thinks they are toys.

episodes.title: The Secret Recipe
episodes.summary: Blythe may have to share her secret with Youngmee to save her from looking foolish on a television show and to save their friendship.

episodes.title: Winter Wonder Wha...?
episodes.summary: Blythe and Zoe are accidentally whisked away for a weekend at the Biskits winter chateau; meanwhile the pets are busy cheering up a visiting homesick penguin.

episodes.title: Snow Stormin'
episodes.summary: A massive snow storm hits Downtown City trapping Blythe and the pets at Littlest Pet Shop.

episodes.title: Back Window
episodes.summary: While Russell is laid up after spraining some quills, he is convinced he catches Josh Sharp stealing Blythe's discarded sketches from the recycling bin.

episodes.title: Room Enough
episodes.summary: Blythe second-surmises her frilly room in the wake of perusing a magazine about popular high schooler rooms while the pets get peppered by a curious kitten who wants to know why Blythe can talk to them.

episodes.title: Why Can't We Be Friends?
episodes.summary: Blythe meets another young lady at the thrift shop and dismisses her old companions; Vinnie becomes friends with a spider but he has to hide his friend from Sunil because he is afraid of arachnids.

episodes.title: Pet Sounds
episodes.summary: Minka's cousin mistakenly thinks his owner has invented a helmet that allows pets to talk to humans.

episodes.title: The Sister Story
episodes.summary: Roger's super competitive sister, Mo, Blythe's aunt comes for a visit, bringing them a constant desire of outdoing each other.

episodes.title: A Night at the Pawza
episodes.summary: Blythe and Mrs. Twombly help a friend to make a showplace out of her rundown pet hotel, in spite of Fisher Biskit's determination to close down the place.

episodes.title: Proud as a...Peacock?
episodes.summary: The pets try to help a shy peacock prepare for his big first appearance at the agricultural gardens.

episodes.title: Sue Syndrome
episodes.summary: Sue needs to conquer a trepidation; Pepper is disheartened over a skunk camper.

episodes.title: In the Loop
episodes.summary: When Harold, an obnoxious groundhog, arrives at the day camp, Russell cannot wait for the day to end but is horrified to discover it never does.

episodes.title: It's the Pet Fest! (1)
episodes.summary: Zoe tries to impress her new friend Heidi, Blythe races against time to relocate the Pet Fest.

episodes.title: It's the Pet Fest! (2)
episodes.summary: Zoe tries to impress her new friend, Heidi; Blythe races against time to relocate the Pet Fest after the original venue falls through.

episodes.title: The Tortoise and the Heir
episodes.summary: While Blythe ponders her life's calling, a 150 year-old giant tortoise with an interesting past comes to the day camp and shares some life-changing information with her.

episodes.title: Pitch Purrfect
episodes.summary: Zoe enlists the pets to form a singing group to compete in the Alley Cappella championships while Blythe is too distracted by her mother's journal to help search for Mrs. Twombly's missing doorknobs.

episodes.title: Ivan the Terrific
episodes.summary: Blythe helps Youngmee in her search for the perfect pet while the LPS pets in the day camp must deal with a wayward circus bear.

episodes.title: Senior Day
episodes.summary: Russell agrees to let his father Jerry move in with him; Blythe befriends an elderly woman who is eager to have Blythe meet her kindhearted granddaughters.

episodes.title: Littlest Pet Shop of Horrors
episodes.summary: Blythe and the gang have a scary story telling contest while a severely jet-lagged Roger thinks he's living an actual nightmare as he desperately tries to make it home.

episodes.title: Game of Groans
episodes.summary: Russell's dream comes true when Blythe takes him, Vinnie and Sunil to the Renaissance Faire in Downtown City Park.

episodes.title: The Tiniest Animal Store
episodes.summary: A TV producer creates a sitcom based on the Littlest Pet Shop, but Blythe worries it will reveal her secret.

episodes.title: Spendthirfty
episodes.summary: Blythe gets a second job as a sales clerk at the Thrifty Armoire and struggles to keep her spending under control while the pets are driven bonkers by a demanding doll that Blythe has left in their care.

episodes.title: Un-vetted
episodes.summary: Zoe develops a crush on the new veterinarian's German Shepard while Blythe and Russell spend the night camping on a freezing mountain.

episodes.title: Pump Up the Panda
episodes.summary: It's fun at the beach where Blythe debuts her new pet beachwear line while Penny Ling meets a lobster eager to "get her in shape" and Sunil and Vinnie face off in an intense sandcastle-building contest.

episodes.title: Snipmates
episodes.summary: Blythe faces off against the hyper-competitive McKenna on a fashion reality show, while back at Littlest Pet Shop the gang tries to figure out why Sugar Sprinkles is so out of sorts.

episodes.title: Guilt Tripping
episodes.summary: Blythe is wracked with guilt when her temporary lapse in judgment gets the Biskits suspended from school while Pepper is on pins and needles awaiting Vinnie's punishment for breaking his lucky rock.

episodes.title: Petnapped!
episodes.summary: Youngmee and Blythe try to save a cocker spaniel from her impostor owner, while the pets try to reenact an episode of Russell's favorite TV show.

episodes.title: Steamed
episodes.summary: Blythe helps Mrs. Twombly prepare her new coffee shop for its grand opening.

episodes.title: Two Peas in a Podcast
episodes.summary: The Biskits try to recreate Blythe's vlogcasting success by doing one of their own, while the pets think Penny Ling is going to be moving away.

episodes.title: Go Figure!
episodes.summary: Things get complicated when Sunil and Vinnie get lost at a sci-fi convention while Minka tries to go Zen with help from a new day camper.

episodes.title: A Doggie Biskit
episodes.summary: Blythe and Zoe help Mrs. Biskit train her new pooch for the purebred dog show, while the rest of the pets deal with the return of Wiggles McSunbask.

episodes.title: It's a Happy, Happy, Happy, Happy World
episodes.summary: Sunil meets a new day camper who is the happiest pet ever and Blythe loses something very important to her.

episodes.title: Race Team: Buttercream
episodes.summary: At the Bunny Races, Buttercream changes personality and becomes a speed demon, then switches back and loses a race, and Blythe's smartphone, in the process.

episodes.title: On the Same Page
episodes.summary: Blythe's afraid she may lose the ability to communicate with the pets while the pets have let a petty argument keep them from communicating altogether.

episodes.title: Paint a Picture, It Lasts Longer
episodes.summary: When Minka paints in a new style that everyone loves except her, she makes Blythe promise to keep her name a secret, which she does… by taking credit for it.

episodes.title: Bake It 'til You Make It
episodes.summary: It's a musical disaster when Blythe and the Pets try to calm a nervous Moose whose incessant bellowing threaten to spoil Mrs. Twombly's big singing quartet reunion.

episodes.title: LPS: The Moosical
episodes.summary: It's a musical disaster when Blythe and the Pets try to calm a nervous Moose whose incessant bellowing threaten to spoil Mrs. Twombly's big singing quartet reunion.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.summary: Penny Ling is intrigued by a red panda who comes to the day camp and Blythe writes a short story based on her parents as teens.

episodes.title: Littlest Pet Street (1)
episodes.summary: Blythe is able to get viral video star Felina Meow to appear at Littlest Pet Street's Grand Opening, but she and the pets have to fly to her island home to pick her up for her appearance.

episodes.title: Littlest Pet Street (2)
episodes.summary: Blythe, Roger and the pets are trying to get off the island, while Mrs. Twombly is desperate to get everything ready for the Grand Opening of Littlest Pet Street.
